output.summary: A genus of evergreen aromatic trees and shrubs with no explicitly stated native origin, distributed across tropical and subtropical Asia and Oceania. Their leaves and bark contain aromatic oils. Inner bark from several species supplies cinnamon, while C. tamala is used as Indian bay leaf.
output.edibilityNote: Inner bark from several species is used as cinnamon; C. tamala is used as malabathrum, tejpat or Indian bay leaf.
